vault.noRecent: No recent vaults — open a database file first
vault.hint: Every entry, category and your master password live in this one file — it is the whole backup. Copy it to a USB stick, a sync folder or another machine, or switch to a different file at any time.
vault.notDb: That file is not a Mend database.
vault.dirUnwritable: That location is not writable (read-only folder or restricted permissions) — please pick another folder.

settings.pageHint: Personalize Mend and make it work your way
settings.themeHint: Follow the system or pick the theme you like
settings.autoLockHint: Locks the vault after the chosen period without mouse or keyboard input
settings.changePasswordHint: Verifies the old password and re-wraps the master key; existing data is not re-encrypted
settings.passwordTooShort: Master password must be at least 4 characters
settings.passwordMismatch: The two new passwords do not match
settings.siteIconsHint: When online, fetch the real favicon from each entry's own URL and cache it in the vault. Turn it off for zero network requests; the list falls back to the bundled brand icons.
settings.clearIconsHint: Deletes the cached site icons; they are fetched again when online
settings.deviceUnlockHint: Open the vault with the key stored on this machine, without asking for the master password
settings.deviceUnlockWarning: The key is stored in plain text in the data folder: anyone who can reach this machine or that folder can read the vault. Only turn this on when this machine is yours alone.
settings.deviceUnlockConfirm: The master password will no longer be asked at startup, and the key will sit in plain text in the data folder — anyone with access to this machine can open the vault. Turn it on?
settings.deviceUnlockOff: Password-less unlock is off — the master password is required at startup
settings.offlineHint: No external network requests: no site icon fetching and no update checks or downloads. Icons already cached keep working.
settings.offlineConfirm: Offline mode stops all external requests: site icons will no longer be fetched, and updates will not be checked or downloaded. Cached icons stay visible, and you can turn this off anytime. Turn it on?
settings.offlineOn: Offline mode is on — no external requests will be made
settings.closeMinimizeToTrayHint: Minimize to the system tray instead of quitting when you click the close button. Right-click the tray icon to open the main panel, open Settings or quit. Asked once on first close; afterwards this switch is the only control.
settings.autoStartHint: Launch Mend automatically when you sign in (desktop only; registers a login item for the current user)

update.title: Update
update.hint: Checks for new versions on launch and notifies you when one is available. You can also check manually anytime.
update.checkIntervalHint: Checks on launch at the chosen interval: every launch / weekly / monthly / yearly
update.upToDate: You are on the latest version
update.availableBodyPlain: A new version is available. Update now?
update.noNotes: No release notes for this update.
update.offlineSkipped: Offline mode is on — no update request was made
update.running: Updating — the app will restart when it finishes
update.readyHint: This update was fully downloaded and verified last time. The button below installs it directly and restarts the app — no re-download.
update.pendingResume: The last update did not finish. Install it now to continue.
update.installStuck: The update did not finish installing. If an update is already downloaded, it will continue on the next launch; you can also retry later.
